description: This file defines the 'ExecCommandResolution' struct and associated static methods to resolve, parse, and analyze command execution strings. It includes logic for handling shell command parsing, resolution of executables, and pattern collection for allowlisting. The code appears to be part of a larger security or command execution management system.

classes.name: ExecCommandResolution
classes.description: A struct representing a resolved command execution, including raw, resolved path, executable name, and current working directory.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Main entry point to resolve a command, attempting raw command resolution first.

methods.name: resolveForAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves commands for allowlist purposes, parsing shell wrappers and command chains.

methods.name: resolveAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Recursively collects allowlist patterns based on command input.

methods.name: resolveExecutable
methods.description: Resolves the executable path and name from a raw command string.

methods.name: resolveShellSegmentExecutable
methods.description: Resolves a shell segment into an executable resolution.

methods.name: collectAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Recursively traverses commands to collect patterns for allowlisting, handling nested environments and shell wrappers.

methods.name: unwrapShellMultiplexerInvocation
methods.description: Checks if the command is a shell multiplexer invocation (like busybox), and unwraps it if so.

methods.name: parseFirstToken
methods.description: Parses the first token from a command string, handling quotes.

methods.name: tokenizeShellWords
methods.description: Splits a shell command string into tokens, respecting quotes and escape characters.

methods.name: splitShellCommandChain
methods.description: Splits a shell command chain into individual segments, respecting quoting and delimiters.
